title: Protocol to maintain single functional mouse hematopoietic stem cells in vitro without cell division
protocol: Harvest bone marrow cells from femora, tibiae, and pelvic bones by crushing them in 10 mL PBS 2% FCS using a mortar and pestle.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 50 mL conical polypropylene centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 300 x g at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 3 mL PBS/FCS.
Lose red blood cells by adding 5 mL Ammonium Chloride (NH4Cl, STEMCELL), incubating on ice for 10 minutes, and vortexing after the first 5 minutes.
Fill the tube up to 50 mL with PBS/FCS and centrifuge for 5 minutes at 300 x g at room temperature.
Resuspend the cells in 500 μL/mouse PBS/FCS.
Transfer the resuspended cells into a polystyrene round-bottom tube.
Add 1 mL of PBS/FCS to the empty 50 mL conical polypropylene centrifuge tube and use these leftover cells for preparing control samples of non-depleted cells.
Filter the suspension using a 50-μm filter.
Use 100 μL of this suspension into each of the FACS control tubes (unstained, 7AAD only, FITC only, PE only, APC only, PE-Cy7 only, BV421 only).
Add 10 μL/mouse EasySep Mouse Hematopoietic Progenitor Cell (HSPC) Isolation cocktail.
Incubate for 15 min on ice.
Add 15 μL/mouse EasySep Streptavidin RapidSpheres.
Incubate for 15 min on ice.
Add PBS/FCS to a total of 2.5 mL.
Insert the tube into the EasySep Magnet and incubate for 3 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant into a new tube.
Repeat the magnet incubation step one additional time.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 min at 300 x g at room temperature.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μL/mouse PBS/FCS and transfer into a polypropylene tube.
Vortex the cells in each tube.
Incubate on ice in the dark for 30 min.
Wash the cells by adding 1 mL of PBS/FCS to each tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 x g at room temperature.
Resuspend the control tubes in 300 μL PBS/FCS.
Add 1:1000 7AAD to the 7AAD-only control tube.
Resuspend the sample tube in 500 μL/mouse of 1:1000 7AAD in PBS/FCS.
Filter the suspension using a 50-μm filter into a new polypropylene tube.
Add 500 μL of 1:1000 7AAD in PBS/FCS to the original tube to rinse out remaining cells.
Transfer rinsed cells to the new tube through the 50-μm filter.
On a SSC-A vs FSC-A plot, gate a region which excludes most of the dead cells and debris and very large cells.
Gate on single cells using pulse width and FSC-A.
Exclude dead cells by gating 7AAD-negative cells.
To set the SLAM population, gate CD48- CD150+ cells, being careful not to go too high into the CD48dim population.
From the SLAM population, gate CD45+EPCR+cells with a relatively strict EPCR+ gate.
Gate Sca-1high cells from the ESLAM Sca-1high population which has an increased proportion of LT-HSCs but reduced overall yield.
Use the single-cell deposition unit of the sorter to place 1 cell into each of the wells of U-bottom 96-well plates, each well having been preloaded with 50μL media.
Load 50μL media supplemented with a 2X cytokine concentration to bring the final medium to 1X cytokines.
